0022600103.text: Neither the Trail Blazers nor the Kings have played a 2026-27 game yet, and Portland, the away side, is missing Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness). Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Malik Monk (ankle soreness) and Maxime Raynaud (knee dislocated). The Trail Blazers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 122-110 win in Portland on April 12, 2026.
